uncertainties: The interrupted dream warning is recalled as 'swallowed up' without resolving its agent.
text:
Oh, right...
I still haven't properly
explained things to Ishlar.
What should I do...?
 Explain.
 Stay silent.
I see. So that's
what happened...
Thanks to this sword,
I was able to survive
that storm at sea.
Thanks to this sword,
I was able to survive
that storm at sea.
And in all our battles since,
without the sword's power,
I'm sure...
But...
But...
You're afraid, aren't you?
Now that you know
how tremendous
this power you've gained really is...
Sorry...
I really can't
tell you the details.
I'm sorry...
I can't really
tell you the details.
Why not!?
If you knew too much, Ishlar,
you might get caught up
in the fighting too...
If you knew too much, Ishlar,
you might get caught up
in the fighting too...
I'm something of an outsider.
Perhaps it's not my place
to interfere...
But the way you were
suffering just now
was anything but normal!
...
If that sword is the cause,
I think you ought
to let it go immediately.
Something terrible is going
to happen to you.
That's the feeling I get...
Ishlar...
The Qualified, huh...
That voice speaking to me
didn't seem to be
the sword's will.
It felt more like
it was trying to warn me
about the sword...
The Qualified...
That voice speaking to me
didn't seem to be
the sword's will.
It felt more like
it was trying to warn me
about the sword...
Swallowed... up?
Come to think of it,
I have felt something
like that before...
The Qualified, huh...
I'm sure something
like what happened today
has happened before...
The Qualified...
I'm sure something
like what happened today
has happened before...
When I went with Ardylia
to the Gate of Evocation,
the sword appeared on its own,
